final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: triple-stacked reference diode (equiv L=6), sinks IREF = 10uA
MN0  ibias ibias nr0 vss nfet W=2 L=2 m=8
MN0a nr0   ibias nr1 vss nfet W=2 L=2 m=8
MN0b nr1   ibias vss vss nfet W=2 L=2 m=8
* tail current source 7.5uA (triple-stacked, matches reference)
MT   tail  ibias nt0 vss nfet W=2 L=2 m=6
MTa  nt0   ibias nt1 vss nfet W=2 L=2 m=6
MTb  nt1   ibias vss vss nfet W=2 L=2 m=6
* NMOS input pair (vinp = non-inverting)
M1  n1 vinn tail vss nfet W=10 L=1 m=4
M2  v1 vinp tail vss nfet W=10 L=1 m=4
* PMOS current-mirror load
M3  n1 n1 vdd vdd pfet W=3.2 L=1 m=3
M4  v1 n1 vdd vdd pfet W=3.2 L=1 m=3
* second stage: PMOS CS + triple-stacked NMOS sink (18.75uA)
M7  vout v1 vdd vdd pfet W=1.6 L=0.5 m=11
M8  vout ibias n80 vss nfet W=2 L=2 m=15
M8b n80  ibias n81 vss nfet W=2 L=2 m=15
M8c n81  ibias vss vss nfet W=2 L=2 m=15
* Miller compensation: smaller Rz (raise Rz*Cgs7 pole, cut zero boost), slightly larger Cc
Rz  v1 nx 26k
Cc  nx vout 1.5p
.ends
